subject: Final acceptance checklist, signer orchestration & start-date contingency
messages:
From: Jason Lee <jason.lee@brightretail.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, procurement@brightretail.com
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: MAP + final timeline request (need go/no-go by Friday)

Karthik,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — team was impressed with the latency profile and the cost modeling. Procurement asked me to lock a final mutual action plan and firm dates for signature so they can align their onboarding calendar. Can you confirm the following by EOD Friday 10/30:

- Final MAP with milestones and owners (evaluation cadence, legal review, procurement PO)
- Estimated time window for signatures (DocuSign routing plan)
- Target start date if we sign by the expected window and fallback start if delayed

We have a warehouse pilot kicking off the week of 11/15 so a hard constraint is: production cutover must be no later than 12/01 if possible.

Attaching a short procurement checklist — happy to jump on a quick call.

—Jason
Procurement Manager, BrightRetail

Attachment: brightretail-procurement-checklist.pdf (pdf stub)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Jason Lee <jason.lee@brightretail.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 13:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP + final timeline request (need go/no-go by Friday)

Jason — thanks, and congrats to your team on getting the pilot calendar locked. Below is a runnable MAP + signoff plan that we can convert into a shared doc. I set conservative timeboxes so legal/procurement have room for redlines.

Proposed MAP (high level):
- 10/28: Redwood sends MAP v5 (this email) + commercial summary (owner: Karthik) [attached: BR-4591-MAP-v5.pdf]
- 10/29–10/30: BrightRetail legal & procurement review (owner: BrightRetail)
- 10/30 (by 5pm PT): Final go/no-go decision from BrightRetail exec sponsor (owner: Jason)
- 10/31–11/02: Redwood legal turn on redlines and finalize DocuSign packet (owner: Olga)
- 11/03–11/04: DocuSign routing + signatures (target window)
- 11/08: Contract fully executed and onboarding kickoff scheduled (target)

Signer orchestration (DocuSign plan):
- Primary signer: BrightRetail COO (round 1)
- Secondary: BrightRetail CFO (round 2, after COO)
- Redwood signers: Olga (legal) then Karthik (commercial)
- Estimated elapsed signature window: 24–72 hours once DocuSign is sent, assuming no blocking redlines

Start-date contingency:
- If fully executed by 11/04 -> target start (integration & onboarding sprint): 11/15
- If execution slips to 11/10–11/14 -> compress onboarding; pilot start maintained 11/15 but production cutover pushed to 12/01
- If execution slips beyond 11/14 -> recommend deferring pilot start; new cutover target 12/15

Dependencies & blockers we flagged:
- Legal redlines: we need Procurement to confirm if they require additional SOC2 evidence; if so, delivery adds 48–72h (owner: BrightRetail legal)
- PO vs invoice: if BrightRetail requires PO before signature, provide procurement contact; PO issuance typically adds 2 business days

Attachments: BR-4591-MAP-v5.pdf, commercial-summary-BR-4591.pdf, redlines_legal_v2.docx (current Redwood comments)

Next steps:
1) Jason — confirm exec go/no-go by EOD 10/30.
2) If go: Olga will assemble DocuSign within 24 hours and send the routing plan.
3) Karthik will reserve onboarding slots week of 11/15 and notify CS/PM.

Irene — flagging for legal intake: any objections to the turnaround plan above?

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: BR-4591-MAP-v5.pdf (pdf stub), redlines_legal_v2.docx (docx stub)

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP + final timeline request (need go/no-go by Friday)

Karthik / Olga — quick read: plan looks good. A few operational clarifications from legal/ops: 

- We can turn on a final DocuSign package in 24 hours once we receive an OK from Jason and any remaining commercial redlines. However, we need a minimum 48-hour buffer for payment terms or PO dependencies (Procurement sometimes wants a 48h PO validation).
- SOC2/technical evidence: we have a SOC2 summary + audit contact; if BrightRetail requests full evidence, add 48–72 hours. Recommend Jason confirm whether the SOC2 summary suffices.
- E-Sign flow: we will set Redwood to sign immediately after BrightRetail CFO to avoid extra round trips. Olga will be the first Redwood signer for legal acceptance.

I approve the timeline contingent on: (a) exec go/no-go by 10/30 5pm PT, and (b) BrightRetail confirms PO timing or waives PO requirement. If either condition fails, we shift target DocuSign send to 11/03 and onboarding to 11/22.

Quick approvals: Olga, please prepare the packet for DocuSign (use redlines_legal_v2 as baseline). Karthik — please secure the onboarding slots tentatively and mark them as TENTATIVE until we have fully executed contract.

Irene
Director, Legal Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: internal-esign-template-v3.pdf (pdf stub)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Jason Lee <jason.lee@brightretail.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 17:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP + final timeline request (need go/no-go by Friday)

Jason — appreciate the quick review today. Per your note, your exec sponsor confirmed greenlight at 16:30 PT. That means we will proceed as follows: 

1) Olga will send the DocuSign packet within 3 hours (expect envelope by 20:00 PT). DocuSign routing: COO -> CFO -> Redwood Legal (Olga) -> Redwood Commercial (Karthik).
2) Please confirm the COO and CFO names/emails for routing (if procurement will push PO, CC procurement@brightretail.com).
3) Contingency plan if signatures extend beyond 72 hours: onboarding moves to TENTATIVE and pilot start 11/15 will be on a best-effort basis; production cutover will not be scheduled until contract is fully executed (tentative cutover 12/01 if signed within 11/10 window).

Action items assigned:
- Jason: confirm signer emails and whether a PO is required (due: 10/30 19:00 PT)
- Olga: assemble packet and send DocuSign (due: 10/30 20:00 PT)
- Irene: standby for any legal clarifications post-redline (due: immediate)
- Karthik: hold onboarding slots week of 11/15 (status: tentative)

DocuSign stub: docusign-envelope-stub.url
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.example/deal/BR-4591

If all good, I'll close this MAP and we will monitor signature progress. Thanks again — excited to get BrightRetail onboarded.

Best,
Karthik
